questions.question: What was the life expectancy at birth for females of all races in the year 2000?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_death_rates_life_expectancy.csv')
res = df[(df['Year'] == 2000) & (df['Race'] == 'All Races') & (df['Sex'] == 'Female')]['Average Life Expectancy (Years)'].iloc[0]
result = float(res)

questions.question: In what year did the total population across all races experience the highest age-adjusted mortality rate?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_death_rates_life_expectancy.csv')
sub = df[(df['Race'] == 'All Races') & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes')]
max_row = sub.loc[sub['Age-adjusted Death Rate'].idxmax()]
result = str(int(max_row['Year']))

questions.question: How many more years was the average life expectancy for White women compared to Black women in 2010?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_death_rates_life_expectancy.csv')
wf = df[(df['Year'] == 2010) & (df['Race'] == 'White') & (df['Sex'] == 'Female')]['Average Life Expectancy (Years)'].iloc[0]
bf = df[(df['Year'] == 2010) & (df['Race'] == 'Black') & (df['Sex'] == 'Female')]['Average Life Expectancy (Years)'].iloc[0]
result = round(float(wf - bf), 1)

questions.question: Did the age-adjusted mortality rate for all races and both sexes fall below 800 deaths per 100,000 prior to 2005?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_death_rates_life_expectancy.csv')
sub = df[(df['Race'] == 'All Races') & (df['Sex'] == 'Both Sexes') & (df['Year'] < 2005)]
result = 'yes' if (sub['Age-adjusted Death Rate'] < 800).any() else 'no'

questions.question: What was the mean life expectancy for Black men across the five years from 2000 through 2004?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('cdc_death_rates_life_expectancy.csv')
sub = df[(df['Race'] == 'Black') & (df['Sex'] == 'Male') & (df['Year'].between(2000, 2004))]
result = round(float(sub['Average Life Expectancy (Years)'].mean()), 2)
